newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish broker joins Auerbach Grayson's network.
newsitem.headline: Turkish broker joins Auerbach Grayson's network.

text.p: Turkish brokerage house Ata Securities joined an international broker/dealer network run by U.S. Auerbach Grayson & Company Inc., Ata said in a written statement.

Ata, as the 51st country member of the network, will present existing and potential economic activities, financial instruments and alternative business opportunities in Turkey, to 50 member countries in the network, the statement said.
"We will have an effective role in orienting institutional investors from the USA to Turkey," said Mehmet Sami, assistant general manager of Ata.
He added that they would also be able to secure funds for Turkish companies from the 50 countries as well.

Ata which has a 100 billion lira capital, was the second largest Turkish brokerage with 126.7 trillion lira ($1.4 billion) of stock trading volume in the first eight months of 1996. -- Istanbul Newsroom 0-212-2750875
